workflow.name: Overdue invoices
workflow.description: SQL demo: unpaid invoices past their due date, prioritised and sent to Telegram.

config.query: SELECT i.id AS invoice, c.name AS customer, r.name AS region, i.amount, i.due_on, (SELECT max(ordered_at) FROM orders) - i.due_on AS days_overdue FROM invoices i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE i.paid_on IS NULL AND i.due_on < (SELECT max(ordered_at) FROM orders) ORDER BY i.amount * ((SELECT max(ordered_at) FROM orders) - i.due_on) DESC LIMIT $1::int

steps.name: Prioritise
steps.prompt_template:
The rows below are a wholesaler's unpaid invoices past their due date, as JSON: invoice number, customer, region, amount in euros, due date, days overdue. They are already ordered by amount times days overdue. Write a prioritised follow-up list for the accounts team: the five to chase first and why, then one line on the rest (how many, how much in total). Use only these numbers.

{input}
